income-elasticity.def: Income elasticity of demand: the percent change in quantity demanded divided by the percent change in income. Positive for a normal good (above 1 when demand grows faster than income), negative for an inferior good.

cross-elasticity.def: Cross-price elasticity of demand: the percent change in quantity demanded of one good divided by the percent change in the price of another. Positive for substitutes, negative for complements, near zero for unrelated goods.
